notes.title: Launch Date Update
notes.content:
Hey guys!

We wanted to send a quick update to let you know about the new launch date. Unfortunately, we have had to push the launch back a week from August 23 to August 30. As we went to build the final gold release of the game this week, we learned that the core networking package we purchased from the Unity Asset Store called "API for Firebase" was removed from the store and has stopped working. We have tried contacting the developer, but haven't received a reply.

This is going to require us replacing the Firebase system with another networking library for high scores and leaderboards. We have decided to use the native leaderboard system built into Steam, so this will give us a deeper integration with Steam and even better experience to compete with all your Steam Friends. Unfortunately, as we mentioned above, this will require us to push back launch for one week.

We are overwhelmed by all the signups for the launch waitlist and can't wait to get you all playing our first game. Really looking forward to hearing what you think.

Best,

- The Mashup Studios Crew
